title: Revisiting LLM Homogeneity Through a Multidimensional Lens
abstract: arXiv:2611.01549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Concerns about LLM homogeneity are typically quantified with embedding similarity, which reduces two texts to a single score. We revisit homogeneity with 25 interpretable metrics spanning five dimensions: semantic, lexical, syntactic, structural, and stylistic & presentational. A human study shows that perceived similarity depends on both content (what responses say) and form (how they say it), yet embedding similarity correlates less with human meaning judgments than sentence-level matching ($\rho=0.417$ vs. $0.606$) and not significantly with form judgments ($\rho=0.140$). Across 18 contemporary LLMs, models say similar things in different words: they share global semantics and broad linguistic profiles but remain distinct in lexical characteristics, structural patterns, and interactional conventions. Across releases from 2024 to 2026, models become more like themselves but not more like one another: among significantly changing metric

translated_title: 通过多维视角重新审视大语言模型的同质化
translated_abstract: 关于大语言模型（LLM）同质化的担忧通常通过嵌入相似度来量化，而这种方法将两个文本简化为一个单一的分数。我们通过涵盖五个维度——语义、词汇、句法、结构以及风格与呈现——的25个可解释指标重新审视同质化问题。一项人类研究表明，感知相似度同时取决于内容（回答说了什么）和形式（如何表达），然而嵌入相似度与人类意义判断的相关性低于句子级匹配（ρ=0.417 对比 0.606），且与形式判断无显著相关性（ρ=0.140）。在对18个当代大语言模型的分析中发现，模型们用不同的词语说着相似的内容：它们共享全局语义和宽泛的语言特征，但在词汇特征、结构模式和交互惯例上仍保持差异。纵观2024年至2026年间发布的各代模型，模型变得更像自己，但并没有变得更像彼此：在显著变化的指标中……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出用涵盖语义、词汇、句法、结构和风格呈现五个维度的25个可解释指标取代单一的嵌入相似度来衡量LLM同质化，发现18个当代模型“用不同的词说相似的话”，且2024至2026年间模型变得与自身更一致而非彼此更相似。
en_tdlr: This paper replaces single-score embedding similarity with 25 interpretable metrics across five dimensions (semantic, lexical, syntactic, structural, and stylistic & presentational) to measure LLM homogeneity, finding that 18 contemporary models "say similar things in different words" and that from 2024 to 2026 models become more like themselves rather than more like one another.
